title: Clause encoding of a path
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a path on the $n$ binary coordinates fix values on some coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector in $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The clause formed by negating the literals for the path's fixed coordinates evaluates to $1$ at $x$ if and only if the binary vector corresponding coordinatewise to $x$ agrees with every value fixed by the path.
hypotheses_covered: A path with sign-valued terminal output and binary coordinate assignments
